# Transit Fabric testnet (tester v0.1.0-tester.3)

> Transit Fabric is a decentralized network fabric run as a Bittensor subnet. It is on Bittensor testnet, subnet 611, and the current release is v0.1.0-tester.3 (a pre-release). Nodes carry overlay traffic for each other, route solvers compete on the route table, and validators measure both and set weights. Testnet only: never use mainnet keys or real TAO. Linking a node to a hotkey needs the human to sign: stop and hand off. Verify checksums before running anything you download.

The command-line tools are still named `bwos` in this testnet. tester.3 adds `bwos doctor --json` (health checks with registry codes), `bwos report` (a redacted Issue body) and an agent skill. Agent skill (Claude Code): `/plugin marketplace add transitfabric/releases`, then `/plugin install transit-fabric@transitfabric`. The bug bounty opens soon; reports are welcome now.

Full rules for agents: https://transitfabric.xyz/AGENTS.md

## Downloads and checks

- [Release v0.1.0-tester.3](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/releases/tag/v0.1.0-tester.3): binaries for Linux x86_64 and aarch64 (`bwos-node`, `bwos`, `bwos-probe`, `bwos-solver`, `bwos-validator`, `minimal_solver`), the no-root container image, router images, the link page, `install.sh`.
- [SHA256SUMS](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/releases/download/v0.1.0-tester.3/SHA256SUMS): checksum every file you download against this, and compare the hash of SHA256SUMS itself with the one in the announcement. Releases are not signed yet.
- [MANIFEST.json](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/releases/download/v0.1.0-tester.3/MANIFEST.json): the commit, the toolchain and the file list.
- [All releases](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/releases)

## Quick start

- [Quick start](https://transitfabric.xyz/quickstart.html): wallet, download, node, peer, check. Start here.
- [QUICKSTART.md](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/releases/download/v0.1.0-tester.3/QUICKSTART.md): the same, as a release asset.
- [testers.md](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/releases/download/v0.1.0-tester.3/testers.md): the full tester guide.
- [run-a-node.md](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/releases/download/v0.1.0-tester.3/run-a-node.md) and [run-a-solver.md](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/releases/download/v0.1.0-tester.3/run-a-solver.md)
- [Known limits](https://transitfabric.xyz/known-limits.html): read before reporting a bug.

## Rules for agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://transitfabric.xyz/AGENTS.md): checksum verification, no mainnet, the human-binding handoff, how to report.

## Reporting

- [Bug report or Finding (Issues)](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/issues/new/choose): ordinary bugs, and findings with a reproduction. The Bug report form asks for the version, node kind, `bwos doctor --json` output and the `bwos report` Issue body. Tick "Filed by an agent" on either form (label `agent-filed`).
- [Private advisory](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/security/advisories/new): security findings and exploits. Agents use the API: `POST /repos/transitfabric/releases/security-advisories/reports` (GitHub private vulnerability reporting, enabled on this repository), with `summary` and `description`, and optionally `severity`.
- [Finding template](https://transitfabric.xyz/redteam/FINDING.md): front matter and sections. Use it as the Issue body or the advisory description.
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

## Red-team pack and bounty

- [Red-team pack](https://transitfabric.xyz/redteam/index.html): scoring, measurement, receipts, capacity-bonds, identity and encoding specs, the threat model, the whitepaper, and the simulator (`bwos-sim`) with how to reproduce a finding in it.
- [Bounty](https://transitfabric.xyz/bounty.html): scope, tiers, rules. Opening soon.
- [Register for credit](https://transitfabric.xyz/claim.html): a human signs one message with a wallet. Agents don't do this step.
- [Leaderboard](https://transitfabric.xyz/leaderboard.html)

## Optional

- [Threat model, raw](https://transitfabric.xyz/redteam/threat-model.md)
- [Scoring spec, raw](https://transitfabric.xyz/redteam/scoring.md)
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/transitfabric/releases/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): documentation fixes are welcome as pull requests.

## Findings sandbox (no GitHub account)

- [Upload page](https://submit.transitfabric.xyz): private, no account, no bounty credit. Agents: `curl -sS -F file=@finding.md https://submit.transitfabric.xyz/upload` (optional `-F attachment=@repro.zip`). The reply is JSON with a receipt ID. Limit: 10 uploads a day per address.
